exercises.prompt: Select the correctly vocalized muḍāf vocative: 'O seeker of knowledge!'
exercises.explanation: When the addressed noun after يَا is annexed as muḍāf, it takes the ACCUSATIVE: يَا طَالِبَ العِلْمِ.

feedback.rule: Muḍāf vocative is accusative; single-word definite vocative takes single ḍammah.

exercises.prompt: What case does wāw al-qasam (وَاوُ القَسَمِ) govern in وَاللَّهِ / وَالعَصْرِ?
exercises.explanation: Oath particles (وَ, تَـ, بِـ) are prepositions that govern the object sworn by in the genitive case.
